title: idSCD: Identifying Training Datasets through Semantic Correlation Descriptors
abstract: arXiv:2605.30462v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Can a dataset be recognized from the spurious correlations it induces during training? We argue that datasets leave dataset-specific traces in a model's learned semantic correlation structure: incidental regularities that are predictive within a dataset, but not causal for the underlying task, can be internalized during training. We use this insight to study dataset-level membership inference, moving beyond existing methods that rely on behavioral or distributional evidence such as confidence scores, losses, margins, generated samples, or query responses. We introduce a white-box semantic fingerprinting approach based on semantic correlation descriptors (SCDs), which capture the semantic correlation structure learned by a model and make it comparable across dataset mixtures. In a controlled leave-one-dataset-out diagnostic, SCDs recover dataset-specific changes and perfectly separate matching from non-matching dataset pairs. We

translated_title: idSCD：通过语义相关性描述符识别训练数据集
translated_abstract: 能否从数据集在训练过程中诱发的虚假相关性中识别出该数据集？我们认为，数据集会在模型学习到的语义相关性结构中留下数据集特有的痕迹：那些在数据集内部具有预测性、但对底层任务并非因果性的偶然规律，可能在训练过程中被模型内化。我们利用这一洞察来研究数据集级别的成员推断，超越了现有依赖行为或分布证据的方法（如置信度分数、损失值、间隔、生成样本或查询响应）。我们提出了一种基于语义相关性描述符（SCDs）的白盒语义指纹识别方法，该方法能够捕捉模型学习到的语义相关性结构，并使其在不同数据集混合之间具有可比性。在受控的留一数据集诊断实验中，SCDs 能够恢复数据集特有的变化，并完美地区分匹配与不匹配的数据集对。我们
tldr: 该论文提出基于语义相关性描述符（SCDs）的白盒语义指纹方法，通过捕捉模型在训练中内化的数据集特有虚假相关性结构，实现精准的数据集级成员推断，能完美区分匹配与不匹配的数据集对。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces idSCD, a white-box semantic fingerprinting approach that identifies training datasets by capturing dataset-specific spurious correlation structures internalized during training, achieving perfect separation between matching and non-matching dataset pairs in dataset-level membership inference.
